prompts.isekaiDark:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production background painting for the Isekai dark theme in a calm, premium desktop workspace. Create one 1536 by 1024 landscape PNG, no UI.
Primary request: a beautiful hand-painted anime environment of floating islands over an immense sea of clouds at blue-violet twilight. Evoke discovery, peace and gentle magic, with elegant clean silhouettes, refined atmospheric depth and selective painterly detail. Not photorealistic, not a 3D render, no polygon aesthetic, no grain.
Composition: leftmost 30 percent is quiet, dark indigo and violet sky fading softly to distant haze, deliberately low detail for text. All important subjects lie between 35 and 85 percent of image width and 18 and 80 percent of height. The upper and lower edges are expendable crop space. Keep bottom-right from 55 to 98 percent width and 80 to 98 percent height simple low-contrast cloud shadow for a separate UI panel.
Scene: an indigo sky transitions through lavender to a muted rose horizon. Two celestial moons, a luminous large moon near 47 percent across and 29 percent down, and a smaller moon near 66 percent across and 23 percent down; subtle star points, restrained bloom. A main lush floating island occupies the middle-right, its long tapered weathered rock base descending into cloud haze. A small weathered fantasy lookout tower, delicately shaped wind-swept trees and one fine waterfall spilling from the far right rim give a sense of place. A few small distant islands drift into atmospheric perspective. No floating gems.
Critical integration surface: on top of the main island, clearly show a broad, bare, FLAT elliptical pale stone platform seen obliquely, its center near pixel (855,565), width about 340 pixels and ellipse height about 100 pixels. It is softly moonlit stone, completely blank and unlit, without runes, engraving, beams or magic circles; the application will draw a magic circle here. Leave open uncluttered sky immediately above and just left of this platform from roughly x650 to x1020 and y380 to y510 for animated crystals. Keep tower and trees toward the right rear of the island so they do not obstruct this space.
Lighting/palette: deep ink blue, lavender, restrained blush cloud rims, cool jade greenery. Gentle luminous atmosphere but strong tonal hierarchy and restful broad areas. Beautiful enough as an art print, clear when reduced to a small hero panel.
Constraints: no people, creatures, dragon, birds, crystals, text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermark, frames, panels, icons, interface, lit windows, glowing platform or painted dynamic effects. Full-bleed single cohesive painting.
prompts.isekaiLight:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: Isekai LIGHT theme production background, 1536 by 1024 landscape PNG.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the approved Isekai twilight painting. Change ONLY its time of day, palette, and atmospheric illumination to a beautiful gentle early morning: pearly lavender-blue sky, soft peach horizon, luminous cream cloud sea, fresh cool jade foliage, sun-warmed pale stone. Airy and serene, with enough lavender-blue midtone depth to keep the island shapes and platform readable. Retain the large and small moons as soft pale day moons, same size and position.
STRICT INVARIANTS: exactly preserve the camera, crop, image dimensions, every island silhouette and location, both moon positions and diameters, the tree and tower placement, waterfall route, the broad bare stone platform's exact outline and centre. Do not add, remove or move any objects. The blank platform stays entirely unlit with no magic or runes. The left 30 percent stays quiet and low detail; bottom-right stays simple mist. No people, creatures, gems, crystals, dragon, text, symbols, logos, frames, UI, lens flares or painted dynamic lights. Preserve the elegant hand-painted anime background style and fine material detail. This is a matched day/night pair used under IDENTICAL live overlay positions.
prompts.highfantasyDark:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production anime background painting for the High Fantasy dark theme of an elegant, calm desktop workspace. Single full-bleed 1536 by 1024 landscape PNG.
Primary request: a majestic but welcoming moonlit mountain citadel, in sumptuous hand-painted anime background art. Noble emerald, blue-green night and soft antique gold accents. Fine intentional brushwork, rich atmospheric depth, beautiful restrained luminous light, clean readable silhouettes. Not photorealistic, not a 3D render, not flat polygons, no noisy texture.
Composition: the leftmost 30 percent remains quiet deep emerald-blue sky and distant haze for overlaid text. A huge luminous ivory moon sits at about 43 percent across, 30 percent down (radius around 105 pixels), with ample clear sky crossing its face for a dragon that the app will draw. Snowcapped mountain ranges recede softly into mist. The main citadel occupies 55 to 80 percent of width, from 24 to 73 percent of height, standing on a naturally weathered cliff. Strong elegant central keep, two slightly lower flanking towers, graceful slate-green roofs and subtle old gold architectural trim; it feels like a carefully designed place, not a crowded jumble of fantasy spires. A slender waterfall descends from the cliff edge into the valley haze. Main subjects between 35 and 85 percent width and 18 and 80 percent height. Bottom-right x55-98 percent y80-98 percent is plain dark soft valley mist for an independent status panel; no foreground clutter.
Critical architecture for live UI: nine clearly separated narrow arched window recesses on the three front-facing tower facades, three vertically spaced windows on each tower. All windows are deep DARK, empty, UNLIT recesses, legible against moonlit pale stone; no yellow panes, no light spilling out. Window openings approximately 14-20 pixels wide and 25-32 pixels tall at native size. Six visible UNLIT shallow metal fire bowls on square pale stone pedestals: two on the front castle terrace, two along lower approach terraces, two on nearby rocky outposts, all between 35 and 84 percent width and 50 and 76 percent height. They are simple wide bowls with clear empty dark interiors and NO flames, smoke, hot coals or glow. Arrange architecture naturally; avoid rigid chart-like rows. These empty bowls are required for the application to add beacons.
Lighting: luminous silver-green moonlight outlines stone and snowy summits, calm deep teal shadows, small antique gold trims stay unlit. Rich subtle color separation. Beautiful as a wallpaper, still legible as a small hero.
Constraints: no people, creatures, dragon, birds, fireflies, particles, text, logos, watermarks, frames, UI, lit windows or any flames. No painted status indicators. Do not paint a second moon.

prompts.dungeonDark:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production background painting for the Dungeon theme of a calm atmospheric desktop workspace; single full-bleed 1536 by 1024 landscape PNG. This image is also used in light mode.
Primary request: a beautifully painted anime dungeon entrance, an ancient stone arch with a deep mysterious corridor beyond it. Hand-painted animated-film environment art, sophisticated blue-slate and charcoal stone with subtle moss and aged iron; clean silhouettes, broad soft tonal shapes, selective tactile brush detail, no photographic grit or noise, no 3D render, no simple polygon aesthetic. Moody and inviting to explore, never horror or threatening.
Composition: quiet leftmost 30 percent in deep soft wall shadow for text; low contrast, not a dramatic bright opening. Main arch centered about 55 percent across. Arch opening roughly x38-69 percent, from y27 to 81 percent: tall rounded arch, beautiful thick large hand-cut voussoir stones, wall pillars on either side and a receding inner arch. Main subjects within y18-82 percent for phone crops. The corridor inside the arch falls into a clearly visible deep blue-black recess; keep it empty and calm, with no figure or eyes. The bottom-right x55-98 percent and y80-98 percent is subdued plain flagstone and shadow where a UI counter will sit.
Four required unlit torches: exactly two prominent old iron wall sconces with dark wrapped wooden torch heads flanking the arch, their torch tips near (400,455) and (1140,455); exactly two smaller unlit torch sconces inside the corridor near (680,530) and (915,530), foreshortened with perspective but clearly visible. Each torch head is charcoal brown, unlit and unburning. Leave space immediately above each head for the app's flame overlay. No flame, ember, coal, orange glow or smoke anywhere.
Soft dim cool ambient illumination from out of frame above makes the arch, each torch tip, and flagstone paths readable. Warm reflected torchlight will be added dynamically by the application. A few hanging chains near the sides, restrained age and moss, elegant alternating cool planes in the stonework. Leave a clear bare floor patch left of the arch around x26-39 percent y74-86 percent, where the app draws treasure chests; do not paint chests. Keep distant passage truly dark for animated eyes.
Constraints: no text, symbols, runes, logos, frames, UI, people, creatures, skulls, skeletons, eyes, treasure, chests, fire, sparks, smoke, lit torches or bright portal. The four unlit torch heads must remain easy to locate against their walls. Single cohesive premium fantasy background painting.
